name: Being A Know It All
overview: Scripture warns against the arrogance of claiming complete knowledge, as seen in Job's challenge to understand the earth's vastness. Proverbs teaches humility, urging believers not to be wise in their own eyes but to fear the Lord and turn from evil. The wise exercise discretion, often concealing knowledge rather than boasting, while fools openly declare foolishness. True understanding is granted to those who seek it with humility, and commendation should come from others rather than self-praise.
